roots.title: Variational Analysis
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Variational Analysis; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Set Convergence
children.top_down_role: Convergence structures for sets, graphs, multifunctions, and extended-real-valued functions, together with their compactness, stability, variational, and failure regimes.

children.title: Variational Geometry
children.top_down_role: First-order local geometry of sets and epigraphs, tangent-normal relationships, regularity regimes, geometric constructions, and failure phenomena.

children.title: Variational Principles
children.top_down_role: Navigation for minimizer existence, perturbational minimization principles, first-order minimality, multiplier theory, constraint qualifications, and their representation and certificate interfaces.

children.title: Generalized Differentiation
children.top_down_role: Generalized first- and second-order differential constructions for nonsmooth functions, sets, and set-valued mappings, together with their calculus, variational foundations, stability interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Metric Regularity
children.top_down_role: Regularity of set-valued mappings, residual error bounds, perturbation stability, structured local geometry, and computational certification.

children.title: Generalized Equations
children.top_down_role: Generalized equations as a unifying language for variational systems, with emphasis on solution mappings, regularity, sensitivity, linearization, and local computational interfaces.

children.title: Monotone Operators
children.top_down_role: Operator classes, maximality and representation, resolvents, fixed-point machinery, monotone inclusions, classical splitting interfaces, Halpern iteration, certificates, convergence regimes, and structural boundaries.

children.title: Variational Inequalities
children.top_down_role: Core finite-dimensional variational inequality theory, its monotone-operator foundations, computational certificates, principal algorithm families, and complementarity interfaces; PDE regularity, stochastic approximation, generalized differentiation, and application models remain external chapter dependencies.

children.title: Second-Order Variational Analysis
children.top_down_role: Second-order variational objects, calculus, optimality principles, stability theory, geometric regimes, evaluation methods, computational interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Integral Variational Analysis
children.top_down_role: Measurable integrands, integral functionals, variational convergence, existence and relaxation, and variational optimality for integral problems.

children.title: Variational Dynamics
children.top_down_role: Continuous-time variational systems governed by set-valued, constrained, dissipative, metric, and rate-independent dynamics; static variational analysis, optimal control, optimal transport, and application-specific PDE theory enter only through interfaces.

children.title: Wasserstein Variational Geometry
children.top_down_role: Static and dynamic optimal transport, Wasserstein metric and variational geometry, gradient-flow structures, computational realizations, generalized transport models, and their principal validity and failure regimes.
